items.title: Build Listing Discovery Engine (PWA or React UI)
items.body:
Create a simple web interface that pulls verified listings from ListingRegistry events.

Features:
- Connect via wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect)
- Read ListingVerified events and metadata
- Show seller trust tier from StakingModule
- Filter by keyword, trust tier, or timestamp

Type: Frontend / UI  
Labels: help wanted, frontend, bounty

items.title: Implement DAO-compatible Slashing Module
items.body:
We need a smart contract module that allows $NOBAY stakers to be slashed for fraud or dispute resolution.

Features:
- Slash by DAO vote or dispute outcome
- Integrates with StakingModule
- Emits Slashed(address, amount, reason)

Bonus: Add trust decay function over time

Type: Smart contract / DAO extension
Labels: enhancement, bounty, Solidity

items.body:
## Background

At Project Galaxy, we are building the infrastructure to power an open and collaborative credential data network. We help Web3 developers leverage credential data to build better products and communities. At the same time, data curators contribute to our credential data network while earning income once the data is utilized. You can learn more about Project Galaxy at our [website](http://galaxy.eco) and this [deep dive](https://blog.galaxy.eco/deep-dive-into-project-galaxy-abd33eceb19b) article.

[https://polygonscan.com/tx/0x74aed47b6cb146d643ac07722029dbd228c995aa6dab69a19d2f22fccaf40b47](https://polygonscan.com/tx/0x74aed47b6cb146d643ac07722029dbd228c995aa6dab69a19d2f22fccaf40b47)

[https://bscscan.com/tx/0x29c88c719d1a16db784aca9b0ef33970239aba0d4dec03bbb7b126afa8a55f7d](https://bscscan.com/tx/0x29c88c719d1a16db784aca9b0ef33970239aba0d4dec03bbb7b126afa8a55f7d)

## Task

We are looking for experienced developers to improve our core smart contracts and help us reduce the gas used when the contracts are invoked.

Contract repo: [https://github.com/ProjectGalaxyHQ/galaxy-contracts](https://github.com/ProjectGalaxyHQ/galaxy-contracts)

Contract technical specifications: [https://github.com/ProjectGalaxyHQ/galaxy-contracts/blob/main/SPECIFICATION.md](https://github.com/ProjectGalaxyHQ/galaxy-contracts/blob/main/SPECIFICATION.md)

Feel free to ask any questions on our [Discord](https://discord.io/ProjectGalaxyHQ) #developer channel.

## Scope

- SpaceStationV2: [https://github.com/ProjectGalaxyHQ/galaxy-contracts/blob/main/contracts/SpaceStation/SpaceStationV2.sol](https://github.com/ProjectGalaxyHQ/galaxy-contracts/blob/main/contracts/SpaceStation/SpaceStationV2.sol)
- StarNFTV3: [https://github.com/ProjectGalaxyHQ/galaxy-contracts/blob/main/contracts/StarNFT/StarNFTV3.sol](https://github.com/ProjectGalaxyHQ/galaxy-contracts/blob/main/contracts/StarNFT/StarNFTV3.sol)

## Rules

Please submit a PR including stats on gas before and after modifications in various invoke path. Please make a good faith effort to avoid privacy violations, destruction of data, and interruption or degradation of our service. Bounty can be marked as complete once the PR is approved and merged.

- NFT must follow [EIP712](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-712) standard
- NFT must implement [IStarNFT](https://github.com/ProjectGalaxyHQ/galaxy-contracts/blob/main/contracts/interfaces/IStarNFT.sol) interface
- NFT must be auto recognizable by Opensea
- SpaceStation must implement [ISpaceStation](https://github.com/ProjectGalaxyHQ/galaxy-contracts/blob/main/contracts/interfaces/ISpaceStation.sol) interface
- Claim one NFT without fee gas must be lower then **150k** gas on Rinkeby
- Events must not be removed

items.title: Sample Template for Bounty
items.body:
## Integrating Convex Finance using OptyFi's DeFi Adapter Interface

### Prize Bounty
5000 USDC

### Description
The bounty is to build an integration with Convex Finance’s liquidity pools using OptyFi's DeFi Adapter interface and [defi-legos](https://github.com/Opty-Fi/defi-legos) library. With this integration, OptyFi users should be able to deposit CRV, CVX and Curve LP tokens into OptyFi vaults which will in turn deploy them into Convex to earn yield boosted by CRV and CVX rewards. The OptyFi Protocol should also be able to deposit CRV and Curve LP tokens acquired from other strategies involving our direct Curve integration.

The overall goal is to maximize the liquidity, utility and profitability of CRV and other Curve assets in DeFi.

### Resources
https://github.com/Opty-Fi/defi-legos - This should help in implementing adapter contracts and data for unit tests 
https://opty.fi/ - This should help to give you a good high-level understanding of OptyFi and what we’re building. https://docs.opty.fi/ - Here you can find more information on the OptyFi Protocol including tokens, pools, vaults, strategies, risk framework, DeFi Adapters and optimization engine. https://github.com/Opty-Fi/defi-adapter-kit - Please refer to Readme.md, contracts/ and test/ for in-depth technical knowledge. https://www.convexfinance.com/

Feel free to join the Builders/Technical channel on our Discord server if you have any questions or need some support.

### Submission
* Follow project [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md)
* The adapter must implement the opty.fi's adapter interfaces
* The adapter contract must be unit tested with minimum 100% test coverage

items.title: [AAVE] Finish aave long/short ETH contract and integrate with shared stake deposit contract
items.body:
There is a WIP AAVE long/short ETH deposit strategy contract here. 

This needs some more thought to figure out the best credit delegation strategy. I.e. from contract to user or vice versa? Or both? 

Also needs to be fixed up, and tested on kovan where AAVE exists but sharedstake doesn't. 
Needs to be able to open a position on AAVE using ETH or stablecoins, on behalf of itself and the user. Needs to be able to credit delegate remaining funds back to the user, or to the contract if the CDP is opened on behalf of the user. 

Needs to be able to withdraw ETH or stables from the CDP. 
Exchange to ETH using uniswap if borrowing stables. 
And finally deposit the ETH to the sharedStake deposit contract and return accumulated vETH2 back to the user. 

[Bounty] This is eligible for a bounty payout
